pages.title: TableView
pages.summary: Sortable, filterable, paginated table over ~25 seeded user rows.

pages.title: TableView — column configuration
pages.summary: Object-form `visibility`, a function `formatter(value, ctx)`, a Mustache `column.template`, per-column `class`, and the `tableOptions` display bundle.

pages.title: TableView — toolbar
pages.summary: `toolbarButtons` in both `handler:` and `action:` forms (one permission-gated), a `toolbarRight` View, live `setTitle()`/`setEyebrow()`, and the `showRefresh`/`showFullscreen` chrome gates.

pages.title: TableView — context menus
pages.summary: Per-row kebab menu: string vs callback `action`, `divider`, `danger`, `disabled`, per-row `visible(model)`, fail-closed `permissions`, and the `rowContextMenu` alias.

pages.title: TableView — inline cell editing
pages.summary: `column.editable` + all four `editableOptions.type` editors, `autoSave: false`, and a live log of all four `cell:*` events including the rejected-save branch.

pages.title: TableView — batch actions
pages.summary: Multi-select rows + bulk actions wired to the in-memory Collection.

pages.title: TableView — custom row class
pages.summary: Custom itemClass (TableRow subclass) with avatar, badges, and expand-on-click.

pages.title: TableView — server collection
pages.summary: Bound to UserList against the live backend, with fetch:error handling.

pages.title: TableView — day-range filter
pages.summary: `dayRangeFilter: true` drops a 1d/7d/30d/90d SegmentControl into the toolbar and auto-applies `created__gte` to the collection.

pages.title: TableView row stripe
pages.summary: Severity-coded 4px left-edge stripe per row, inherited from ListView — same callback, same six tokens.

pages.title: TableView — grouped rows
pages.summary: `groupBy` as a full-width `<tr><th colspan=N>` header, the `groupByField`/`groupByRecency`/`groupByBoolean` helpers, and the four `groupHeaderStyle` treatments.

pages.title: TableView — filter presets
pages.summary: `filterPresets` renders named one-click queries as a toolbar segment (≤4 inline); mutually exclusive, derived active state, `'@me'` token.

pages.title: TableView — stat strip
pages.summary: `stats` renders live server-computed counts above the toolbar; each block is also a one-click filter with derived active state.

pages.title: TableView — feedback states
pages.summary: `emptyState` (configured + filtered-empty branches), `loadingStyle: 'skeleton'`, and `showResultCount` — the loading/empty/summary chrome.

pages.title: TableView — expandable rows
pages.summary: `rowExpand` chevron column opens a full-width string-template detail row; `rowExpandMultiple` toggles single vs many open.

pages.title: TableView — live watch
pages.summary: `autoRefresh: { every, mode: 'models' }` refreshes only the visible rows via one batched `id__in` request and flashes the ones that changed.

pages.title: TableView — power tools
pages.summary: `persistState` + `persistKey` + `columnChooser` (with `hideable: false`) + `autoRefresh: 30` on one wide table; reset via `clearPersistedState()`.
